name: el_rules_at
description: The structure of the editor's placement help, switch-light links and layout checks (vpt/el_rules.py, vpt/el_links.py, the editor page): which symbols each kind of suggestion is for, the switching names, the links layer. The rule definitions, both rule sets and their values, and the snap radius are parameters: presets/el_parameters.json (rules, sections.snap); vpt/el_rules.py load() merges them in.

socket.name: Socket at the centre of a wall piece

light.name: Ceiling light at the room centre

kitchen.name: Kitchen outlets along the walls of a kitchen

switching.note: A light group is a set of lights that share switches (switches and lights joined by links). The page PROPOSES the switch type from the number of switches in the group: one switch: Ausschaltung (one one-way switch); two: Wechselschaltung (two two-way switches); three or more: Kreuzschaltung (two two-way switches and an intermediate switch for every further place). Apply swaps the placed switch symbols to the proposed codes; nothing changes without it. A group with a push-button gets no proposal: push-buttons work an impulse relay or a timer, whatever their number (the Elektroplaner decides). This is the textbook wiring rule; how the group is actually wired is for the Elektroplaner.

links.name_en: control line (which switch works which light)
links.note: A dashed line from a switch or push-button to each light it works, on its own layer. Drawn between the symbols' insertion points (straight lines, not cable routes). Colour and width: presets/el_parameters.json.

checks.note: Which symbols the layout checks count (vpt/el_checks.py, mirrored in the page): sockets are the symbols of socket_category (a symbol listed in outlets_per_symbol counts as that many outlets, e.g. a double socket as two; every other symbol as one); appliance outlets those of appliance_category; a cooker outlet one of cooker_codes; a smoke alarm one of smoke_codes. A room's type is the first of room_types that fits: kitchen (a kitchen_keywords word in its label), wet (the plan marks it a wet room: presets/plan_extract.json wet_room_pattern), then living, bedroom, hall and storage (a room_words_<type> word in its label); none fits: its type could not be told. The thresholds and word lists are parameters (presets/el_parameters.json, rules).
